_meta.source: Curated from published instruct-model evaluations (2025–2026). Abliterated / uncensored finetunes inherit their base model's figures — treat as approximate. Models with no credible published evals carry no benchmark block; absence is honest, not an oversight.

llama3.3-8b-abliterated.basis: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (abliterated finetune — base figures, approx.)
llama3.3-8b-abliterated.notes: Refusal-direction ablation preserves base capability better than DPO uncensoring; strong all-rounder at 5 GB.

qwen2.5-7b-abliterated.notes: Best benchmark-per-GB in the 7B class; the default recommendation when one small model must do everything.

qwen2.5-14b-abliterated.notes: The midpoint: near-30B quality at 9 GB. Good flagship for 32–64 GB hosts.

gemma3-27b-abliterated.notes: Vision-capable. 17 GB — needs the BD790i class; too big for 16 GB hosts.

qwen3-8b-hivemind.notes: 256K context is the headline — the long-context pick for document-heavy workflows.

dolphin3-abliterated.notes: The classic instruction-following uncensored line; very reliable persona adherence.

qwen2.5-coder-7b-abliterated.notes: Highest HumanEval of any 7B here — the coding-step default. Pin it to `coding` role steps.

llama3.2-moe-18b.notes: Experimental community mixture-of-experts merge — no published evals; benchmark block omitted on purpose. Try it on a non-critical workflow first.

qwen3.5-uncensored-9b.notes: Recent finetune — no stable published evals yet for this variant; benchmark block omitted. Strong multilingual reports anecdotally.

qwen3.5-uncensored-35b.notes: Flagship-class uncensored. No published evals for the finetune yet; expect Qwen-3.5-class results. 22 GB — BD790i territory.

dolphin-mixtral.notes: MoE: 26 GB on disk but only ~13B active per token — faster than its size suggests.

deepseek-r1-32b.notes: The strongest reasoner in the catalog — chain-of-thought native. Slow on CPU; budget 3-5 tok/s. Use for the one step that genuinely needs depth.

dolphin-mistral.notes: Aging but quick; pick qwen2.5-7b-abliterated instead unless RAM is very tight.

nous-hermes2-mixtral.notes: Strong instruction adherence; the structured-output pick among the big MoEs.

wizardlm-uncensored-13b.notes: A classic, kept for nostalgia and style — outclassed on every benchmark by the 7B Qwens.

dolphin-phi.notes: 1.6 GB. Surprisingly capable for routing, tagging, and quick-classification steps.

deepseek-coder-33b.notes: Repo-scale code understanding; prefer qwen2.5-coder-7b for speed unless the task spans many files.

mythomax.notes: Tuned for narrative quality, not benchmarks — no meaningful eval figures exist and none are invented here. The storytelling / roleplay pick.

hermes3:8b.notes: Excellent steerability and function-calling; the agent-persona default on this box.

qwen2.5:0.5b.notes: 0.4 GB; instant. For smoke tests, echo steps, and UI development — not for real work.

yi:34b.notes: Deep general knowledge and long-form quality; weak at code. The essayist of the fleet.

qwen2.5-coder:7b.notes: Highest HumanEval per GB in the catalog — the default `coding` role binding.

mistral-nemo:12b.notes: 128K context + tiktoken-class tokenizer; strong multilingual middle-weight.

qwen2.5:7b.notes: The censored twin of the abliterated 7B — same capability, stock guardrails.

nvidia/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4.basis: Qwen3 8B (base figures, approx.) — NVFP4 4-bit float, Blackwell-native
nvidia/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4.notes: The GPU performance path: served by vLLM with continuous batching + fp8 KV cache. Fastest real model on this box by an order of magnitude.
